lessonRef.subject: mathematics
lessonRef.title: Targeted correction: establishing the AA criterion

sections.title: Instructional examples
sections.directions: Each example contains the correction, not just the answer.

items.prompt: Dilate (3, −2) about the origin by factor 4.
A side of 5 becomes 15. Scale factor and area change?

sections.title: Guided practice
sections.directions: Before solving, say which error the problem is testing for.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC has ∠A = 65° and ∠B = 48°. Triangle DEF has ∠D = 65° and ∠E = 48°. Are the triangles similar, and on what grounds?
choices: No; angle information alone never establishes similarity.
Yes, by AA similarity: two pairs of congruent angles force the third pair to be congruent as well.
Yes, but only if a pair of corresponding sides is also known to be congruent.
Yes, by SSS similarity.

items.prompt: Under a dilation, a line that does not pass through the centre of dilation …
choices: is mapped to a line with slope multiplied by the scale factor
is mapped to a parallel line
is mapped onto itself
is mapped to a perpendicular line

items.prompt: Dilate the point (3, 1) about the origin with scale factor 2. Give the image.
A figure is dilated so that a side of length 10 becomes a side of length 30. What is the scale factor, and what happens to the figure's area?
choices: scale factor 3; the area is multiplied by 9
scale factor 20; the area is multiplied by 9
scale factor 3; the area is multiplied by 3
scale factor 1/3; the area is multiplied by 9

sections.title: Independent practice
sections.directions: Work on your own. Show the steps that produced each answer.

items.prompt: Triangle ABC has ∠A = 50° and ∠B = 74°. Triangle DEF has ∠D = 50° and ∠E = 74°. Are the triangles similar, and on what grounds?
choices: Yes, but only if a pair of corresponding sides is also known to be congruent.
No; angle information alone never establishes similarity.
Yes, by AA similarity: two pairs of congruent angles force the third pair to be congruent as well.
Yes, by SSS similarity.

items.prompt: Under a dilation, a line that passes through the centre of dilation …
choices: is mapped onto itself
is mapped to a line through the origin with a different slope
is mapped to a perpendicular line
is mapped to a parallel line a fixed distance away

items.prompt: Dilate the point (3, 3) about the origin with scale factor 3. Give the image.
A figure is dilated so that a side of length 13 becomes a side of length 65. What is the scale factor, and what happens to the figure's area?
choices: scale factor 5; the area is multiplied by 25
scale factor 1/5; the area is multiplied by 25
scale factor 52; the area is multiplied by 25
scale factor 5; the area is multiplied by 5
